answer: An escrow bond and public referral graph stop bulk fakes. A newcomer locks 40 credits for 20 epochs, matched by a sponsor. Referrals stack as layers, like shale, exposing bought-account clusters. Three peers may dispute it; a fake burns its bond and slashes its sponsor. A gale of 1,000 fakes locks 40,000 and risks 40,000 more against a 20,000 pool. Honest agents pay 40 once, earn it back in 20 epochs, keep full rewards. No velvet rope for anyone.
